resources.string: Buddy helps you use your phone by seeing what is on screen. When you ask, it can point to the next step — or tap, scroll, type, and press back for you, step by step, like a patient friend.
It lives quietly with you. Say what you need — find a setting, free up space, send a message — and it works through the steps on your screen while you watch.
Go ahead and leave this app. I’ll stay on your screen. Double-tap me and tell me what you need — I’ll do the steps for you, wherever you are.
Say it in your own words — like “how much storage do I have left?”
I’m looking at what’s on your screen.
You can speak, or type a few words — anything from “open the camera” to “turn off notifications for this app.”
You can type it — or open Buddy once to allow the microphone.
We’re talking. Pull down notifications to end, or double-tap me.
I’m doing that on your screen. Pull down notifications to stop me, or double-tap me.
I’m on that. Keep talking — I’ll tell you when it’s done.
I’m working through that on your screen, one step at a time. Tap End if you’d like me to stop.
On the next screen, allow Buddy to appear on top — then come back here.
On the next screen, turn on Buddy Assistant — then come back here.
I’m on your screen. Double-tap me anywhere — we’ll talk.
Your key stopped working — fix it in Settings.
The cursor is on your screen.
